summary.text: In August 2025, Gianchandani described AI as transformative and characterized test beds as potential infrastructure for a promising AI-enabled future. In April 2026, he emphasized AI's effects on Americans' work and daily activities and advocated broader access to the knowledge, tools and training needed to benefit from it. He also supported overcoming barriers to AI-enabled protein design and advancing AI-enabled scientific experimentation.
